title: Nx Resource API Generator
description: Scaffold api and api-e2e projects for a resource, and reuse or create matching models.

apiName.description: API name in kebab-case (without resource prefix).

scope.description: Workspace package scope for generated api packages (for example @org).

featureName.description: Seed feature name for api routing and model contracts.

templateRoot.description: Optional override path for canonical template source. Defaults to packages/nx-resource/templates/knowledge-graph.
